titulo: Step 3: queues — ten tasks and go to sleep
lead: A single agent does one thing at a time, and only while you're watching. With a durable queue, each request becomes a saved task, resumed if it crashes, and the flows stop at a gate before anything that matters.
objetivo: decide what goes into the queue, where the gates are, and how to check the result the next day.

aprende.t: Where to put the human gate
Measure how many came out right

secoes.sub: From request to result, with resume and gate.

nos.detalhe: Each request becomes a task: in inemaccbot, a message on Telegram; in the homemade queue, a .md file in the entrada/ folder.

itens.t: Picks up where it left off
itens.sub: rodando/ goes back to the entrada

nos.detalhe: The task stays saved. If the computer shuts down or you interrupt it, the next round picks up what is left, without redoing what was already done.
The agent runs one task at a time. If it works, the answer goes to feito; if it errors, it goes to falhou, with the reason, for you to look at.
In the flows that matter, the bot writes and stops. You read, fix it if needed, and only then approve. This is the moment you manage, instead of doing the work.

secoes.volta: Running again only picks up what is left
secoes.legenda: Examples of flows that become tasks in inemaccbot: transcribe, dub, explainer video, course and reel.

rolagem_fim.texto: You send the tasks and go to sleep. The queue saves them, the agent runs one at a time and stops at the gate for what matters. In the morning, you look at feito/ and falhou/.

secoes.sub: Run it, interrupt it halfway and run it again. That is what the homemade queue does.
tarefas: Draft of the post of the week

msg.inicio: 5 tasks in entrada/. Click "Run the queue".
msg.rodando: Running: one task at a time, from entrada/ to rodando/ and then feito/ or falhou/.
msg.parou: Interrupted. The task in the middle stayed in rodando/. Run again to see it resume.
msg.retoma: Resumed: what was in rodando/ went back to entrada/. What was already in feito/ is not redone.
msg.fimfalha: Queue empty. One task went to falhou/ with the reason: that is the one you look at in the morning.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative simulation in the browser: the tasks do not really run. The failure is on purpose, to show the falhou/ folder.

secoes.sub: The durable queue of inemaccbot and the approval gate.
The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You interrupted the queue in the middle of a task. What happens when it runs again?
opcoes: The queue only works again the next day.
The interrupted task goes back to the entrada and the queue continues with what is left.
Everything is redone from the start.
perguntas.explica: That is what makes the queue durable: whatever was left in rodando/ goes back to entrada/, and whatever is already in feito/ is not redone.

perguntas.p: In which task is the human gate most important?
opcoes: Listing the files in a folder.
Summarizing PDFs for you to read yourself.
Publishing a post on behalf of the company.
perguntas.explica: A gate goes before anything that has consequences outside: publishing, sending, spending. Transcribing for internal use can run on its own.

perguntas.p: What is the sign that you are managing, and not just using?
opcoes: Rejecting or correcting a result before approving it, and turning the failure into a rule.
perguntas.explica: E5 and the extra challenge show this: you read, correct, approve, and the task that failed the most gets a new rule in AGENTS.md or in the prompt.
